title: Public Complaints and Grievances
description: Draft public-service guidance; review questions must be resolved before publication.
clarifying_questions: Which service and examination does your question concern?

claims.text: The charter lists a free response to public complaints within one working day; this is not a guarantee of final resolution.
The procedure accepts complaints through approved channels including in person, writing, telephone and email.
Unresolved complaints move from frontline handling to investigation, then Corporate Communications and management; dissatisfied clients may seek external help.

unresolved_questions: Verify current submission contacts and named reviewer approval.
Do not claim the bot submits complaints into KNEC CRM.
